description: This file contains functions related to the Lantiq system, including checking system type and setting up DSL interfaces and modems during device configuration.

methods.name: lantiq_is_vdsl_system
methods.description: Checks whether the system is a VDSL type by inspecting /proc/cpuinfo for specific system identifiers.

methods.name: lantiq_setup_dsl_helper
methods.description: Configures DSL-related settings and modems based on system type, setting up appropriate interfaces and firmware.
